card.name: The word other in lists
card.fires_on: Mostly the word "other" right after "and", "or" or a comma, where a list of risk factors, drugs or mechanisms is continued. It also fires on "for" after "look" and on stray digits or word pieces.

modes.label: "other" extending a list
modes.description: The word "other" follows "and", "or" or a comma and introduces more items of the same kind.
modes.example: surgery and<< other>> procedures, hypoxic states, excessive alcohol

modes.label: Looking for ways
modes.description: A word after "look" or "in many" that leads into "ways" or alternatives.
modes.example: every day we look<< for>> ways to conserve resources

modes.label: Stray digits and name pieces
modes.description: Isolated digits in IDs or emails, or the middle of a place name.

card.writes: It pushes toward "other" and "else" style words, meaning alternatives or additional items, in several languages.
card.plain: It notices where a list is being widened with "other" items or alternatives.
